generate_all_trace_viewer: generate all trace HTML pages and an index page from a run output directory with scenario artifacts
generate_runs_index: generate a runs index landing page that lists all experiments and their split overview pages
generate_trace_page: generate a trace HTML page for a single scenario and return a summary dict with pre-computed stats
generate_index_page: generate an index HTML page from pre-computed scenario summaries without re-reading any files
load_scenario_dag: load and parse a single scenario JSON file to extract its oracle event DAG for display
